autoTunnel.description:
Raise the ProtonVPN tunnel by itself when you join a Public (not marked Trusted) network. It waits for a login page
(the NET pad) and rises once the network passes. Every new network is Public until you mark it Trusted.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

autoTunnelTo.x-wants: a text like fastest or BE
autoTunnelTo.description:
Where that tunnel goes: "fastest", or a country by its two-letter code ("BE").

Takes a text like fastest or BE. Default: "fastest".

autoTunnelOn.description:
Which networks count for it: "any" | "wifi" (a cable never raises it).

Takes "any" or "wifi". Default: "any".

newNetworks.description:
What a network is the first time you join it: "public" | "trusted". (Mark one the other way in the popup.)

Takes "public" or "trusted". Default: "public".

searchSeconds.description:
How long a Bluetooth search runs (the BT SCAN button), seconds, 5..600.

Takes a whole number 5 .. 600. Default: 30.

visibleSeconds.description:
How long the laptop is visible to other Bluetooth devices (the beacon LED), seconds, 10..3600.

Takes a whole number 10 .. 3600. Default: 180.

speedTest.description: The speed test (Cloudflare): the most it may transfer, in MB, 1..5000.

portalCheckUrl.description:
The page the NET pad fetches to tell a login page from the internet (the body must be "NetworkManager is online").

Takes a text like http://.... Default: "http://ping.archlinux.org/nm-check.txt".

enabled.description: Takes true or false. Default: true.

usage.description: Count the data used per network (today / month), in ~/.local/state/lares/aerial/usage.json. Off keeps the file as it is.

traffic.description: Takes true or false. Default: true.

bar.description:
The figures on the bar's network half: whether they come at all, and from how many megabits a second (they stay until half of it).
With "traffic": false the traffic is not read at all while the popup is shut. 1 .. 999.

btLow.description:
A Bluetooth device's battery is told at these percentages (at most four, 1 .. 50 each; [] = never), once each on the way down.

Takes a list of whole numbers. Default: [20,10].

sounds.description:
The popup's sounds (the globe, the drawers). How loud they are is the mockup's.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

look.description:
Which side of the popup the detail panels open on: "start" (the LEFT of a top bar's popup, joined along the panel's long edge, as the
stocks' detail is), "end" (the right) or "far" (below it). A panel never goes off screen.
